data.narrative:
Reditus Space is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Stef Crum (CEO, PhD Space Systems Engineering, prior NASA and Space Force orbital operations and reentry experience) and Will Sherman (CTO). The company has raised $7.1M to date. The valuation universe encompasses 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable triangulation technique. Using total capital raised ($7.1M) as a proxy baseline, a 2.5x step-up multiplier reflects typical progression from seed to the next institutional funding round, yielding an implied valuation of $17.75M. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (sector median 24.4x across 6 tickers) cannot be applied without the target's revenue figures, which remain proprietary. Peer-median analysis is similarly inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow aerospace financing universe; only 1 same-stage peer was identified across the dataset.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, centered on $18M. The median reflects stage-typical dilution and capital deployment patterns. Key uncertainties include revenue traction (undisclosed), product maturity, and the absence of comparable seed-stage financing data in the sector. The range is narrow because only one method yielded defensible output; widening conviction would require either disclosed revenue for public-comp triangulation or identification of 3+ comparably-staged private financings.
